subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Your Microsoft 365 password expires in 2 hours
body:
Dear Employee,

Our records show that your Microsoft 365 password will expire in 2 hours. To avoid losing access to your mailbox and Teams, you must verify your account immediately using the secure link below:

https://login-microsoft365.nimbus-tech-support.com/verify?user=priya.sharma

subject: Quick favour - confidential
body:
Hi Arjun,

Are you at your desk? I am stuck in a board meeting and need a quick favour. I need you to purchase 10 Amazon gift cards of Rs 10,000 each for a client appreciation programme. Keep this confidential, it is a surprise. Scratch the codes and send me photos on this email within the next 30 minutes. I will reimburse you today.

Sent from my iPhone
Rahul

subject: Diwali celebration on 6th November - register your team
body:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce our Diwali celebration on 6th November at the Pune office cafeteria. Please register your team for the rangoli competition on the HR portal: https://hr.nimbustech.in/events/diwali-2026

Lunch will be served from 1 PM.

Warm regards,
People Team

subject: Overdue Invoice #7781 - please process today
body:

body:
